title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated LLM calls and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework in which the agent composes robot primitives, including vision-language-action (VLA) policies, into Python cells that check and retry locally and return only the images and state they request. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, it raises success from 63.1% to 71.7% over tool calling with the same GPT-6 Astra planner and primitives, using 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens on jointly solved instances. On RoboDojo, without any VLA policy or privileged information, it reaches 51.6% average success rate (Score 58.2), 19.4 points above the top entry of the public leaderboard. Based on the PyRUA-Lean framework, we train PyRUA-Lean Coder v0.1-4B, an open 4B model, with GRPO on 45 LIBERO-PRO instances; it improves from 18.8% to 44.1% on unseen task instances, surpassing the Qwen3.5-27B base model.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical graduate seminar called Interactive Robotics and Language Models, today's lecture is on pie-roo-ah lean. Work such as Code as Policies and Harness V-L-A shows a field exploring how language models can direct existing robot skills. This paper asks whether the interface between model and robot can reduce repeated planning without training a new policy. The distinction matters when every dependent step triggers another model call. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门假设叫“交互式机器人与语言模型”的研究生研讨课上，今天的讲座主题是pi-roo-ah lean。像《Code as Policies》和《Harness V-L-A》这样的工作，展示了一个正在探索语言模型如何指挥现有机器人技能的领域。这篇论文要问的是，模型和机器人之间的接口能否在不训练新策略的情况下减少重复规划。当每一个依赖步骤都会触发另一次模型调用时，这个区别就很重要了。诺亚，你有什么问题？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, is the central contribution a new robot skill or a different way of coordinating existing ones?
segments.zh: 教授您好，这篇论文的核心贡献是提出了一项新的机器人技能，还是提供了一种协调现有技能的不同方式？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It is the latter. Imagine a simulated robot placing a bowl on a plate. In one recorded example, the tool-calling baseline takes four model turns to locate the bowl, sample its base, lower it, and release it. Pie-roo-ah lean replaces those turns with one executable Python cell. That cell makes several decisions, checks outcomes, and asks for an image only if the task is still unfinished. This is one successful example, not a guarantee.
segments.zh: 是后者。想象一个模拟机器人在把碗放到盘子上。在一个记录下来的例子里，调用工具的基线需要四轮模型交互才能定位碗、采样它的底部、把它放低、再松手。Pie-roo-ah lean 把这些轮次替换成一个可执行的 Python 单元。这个单元会做若干决策、检查结果，并且只有在任务仍未完成时才请求一张图像。这是一个成功的例子，并不保证每次都行。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So what exactly counts as a robot skill in this comparison?
segments.zh: 那在这个对比里，到底什么才算是一项机器人技能呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper calls these operations primitives: existing actions such as moving, sensing, gripping, or invoking a learned vision-language-action policy. With ordinary tool calling, the model selects a primitive, receives its result, and must call again to choose a dependent action. Motion calls also return images and state automatically. The important point is that the robot’s underlying operations stay the same; what changes is how the model can combine them.
segments.zh: 论文把这些操作称为原语：也就是已有的动作，比如移动、感知、抓取，或者调用一个学习到的视觉-语言-动作策略。在普通的工具调用中，模型选择一个原语，收到结果，然后必须再次调用才能选择依赖它的下一步动作。运动调用还会自动返回图像和状态。关键在于，机器人底层的操作保持不变，变化的是模型组合这些操作的方式。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In pie-roo-ah lean, the model writes a Python cell that can call those same primitives, keep variables and helper functions, branch on results, and retry locally. Intermediate information can remain inside the program rather than returning to the model after every step. At the end, the cell returns requested printed output and images. In the bowl example, the cell computes a target from scene geometry, conditionally lowers and releases, and prints five lines without returning an image.
segments.zh: 在π0的设定里，模型会写一个Python单元，可以调用同样的那些原语，保留变量和辅助函数，根据结果分支，并在本地重试。中间信息可以留在程序内部，而不必每一步都返回给模型。最后，这个单元会返回请求的打印输出和图像。在碗的例子中，这个单元根据场景几何计算目标，有条件地下降并释放，然后打印五行内容，不返回图像。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does the comparison isolate which of those interface features produces the improvement?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：这个对比有没有单独区分出到底是哪些接口特性带来了提升？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. It compares the complete interfaces, not primitive composition, retained state, and selective feedback one feature at a time. The main evaluation uses the same G-P-T six Astra planner, robot stack, and frozen V-L-A policies for both agents. It covers 700 simulated task instances across three benchmarks, with benchmark-specific success checks and equal call budgets: generally 40 calls per episode, or 100 for RoboCasa365 composite tasks.
segments.zh: 不。它比较的是完整的接口，而不是逐个特性地比较原始组合、保留状态和选择性反馈。主要评估对两个智能体都使用相同的GPT-6 Astra规划器、机器人栈和冻结的V-L-A策略。它覆盖三个基准中的700个模拟任务实例，使用针对各基准的成功检查和相同的调用预算：通常每个回合40次调用，RoboCasa365复合任务则为100次。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Under those conditions, benchmark-checked success is 71.7% for pie-roo-ah lean and 63.1% for R-Pent tool calling, an 8.6-percentage-point difference. Efficiency is measured on the instances both agents solved: there, mean model calls fall from 17 to 8.7, and mean input tokens fall from 788,000 to 276,000. Those token means include cached and post-success input, and are not averages over every attempt.
segments.zh: 在这些条件下，经基准检验的成功率，pi-roo-ah lean 是 71.7%，R-Pent 工具调用是 63.1%，相差 8.6 个百分点。效率是在两个智能体都解决了的实例上衡量的：在那里，平均模型调用次数从 17 次降到 8.7 次，平均输入 token 从 788,000 降到 276,000。这些 token 均值包含了缓存输入和成功后的输入，并不是对所有尝试取的平均。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Why might combining actions reduce input tokens, and does that mean the system runs faster?
segments.zh: 把动作合并起来为什么能减少输入token，这是否意味着系统跑得更快？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Combining dependent steps can reduce how often the model must receive context and plan again. On jointly solved Libero Pro instances, the accounting separates 2.55 times fewer calls from 1.76 times fewer input tokens per call; together, those factors correspond to 4.48 times fewer total input tokens. That is an accounting decomposition, not a causal test. Fewer calls or tokens do not establish lower elapsed time or total computation.
segments.zh: 把相互依赖的步骤合并起来，可以减少模型需要反复接收上下文并重新规划的频率。在联合求解的 Libero Pro 实例上，账目拆分为调用次数减少 2.55 倍、每次调用的输入 token 减少 1.76 倍；两者合在一起，对应总输入 token 减少 4.48 倍。这是一种账目上的分解，不是因果检验。调用次数或 token 更少，并不能说明实际耗时或总计算量更低。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A useful stress test asks whether fewer returned images alone explain the gains. On Libero Pro, a modified tool-calling baseline that received images only on request fell from 83% to 68.5% success. This supports the view that image selectivity alone does not reproduce the result. But it does not isolate selective feedback inside pie-roo-ah lean or prove composition is the sole cause; the intervention changes the baseline’s observation delivery.
segments.zh: 一个有用的压力测试是看，仅仅减少返回的图像数量，是否就能解释这些提升。在 Libero Pro 上，一个修改过的工具调用基线只在被请求时才接收图像，成功率从 83% 降到了 68.5%。这支持了这样一种看法：仅靠图像选择性并不能复现该结果。但这并没有在 pie-roo-ah lean 内部隔离出选择性反馈，也没有证明组合是唯一原因；这一干预改变的是基线的观测传递方式。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this relate to Code as Policies, which also lets a model write robot programs?
segments.zh: 这和Code as Policies有什么关系呢？那个工作也是让模型编写机器人程序。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Code as Policies had already demonstrated language-model-generated robot programs with feedback logic and geometric computation, so executable robot code itself is not the new claim. The narrower contribution here is an interactive Python interface over R-Pent’s existing primitives, where intermediate results can stay in program state and only selected outputs return to the model. The findings therefore shift attention toward interface design, while leaving each interface component’s independent effect unresolved.
segments.zh: Code as Policies 已经展示了语言模型生成的机器人程序，具备反馈逻辑和几何计算能力，所以可执行的机器人代码本身并不是新的主张。这里更具体的贡献是在 R-Pent 已有原语之上构建了一个交互式 Python 接口，中间结果可以留在程序状态中，只有选定的输出才会返回给模型。因此，这些发现把注意力转向了接口设计，但每个接口组件的独立效果仍未得到解答。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: There are clear boundaries to the evidence. The evaluation uses simulated robot stacks, one run per agent per instance, and one planner setup. It does not test physical robots, other planners, repeated-run reliability, or execution latency. Even the token savings vary by task type: on RoboCasa365 atomic tasks, code uses more input tokens per call on average, though fewer calls still yield fewer total input tokens.
segments.zh: 这些证据有明确的边界。评估用的是模拟机器人栈，每个实例每个智能体只跑一次，而且只用了单一规划器设置。它没有测试真实机器人、其他规划器、重复运行的可靠性，也没有测执行延迟。就连token节省也因任务类型而异：在RoboCasa365的原子任务上，代码每次调用平均消耗更多输入token，不过调用次数更少，总输入token仍然更少。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What should researchers test next to learn whether this interface generalizes?
segments.zh: 研究人员接下来应该测试什么，才能知道这种接口是否具有泛化能力？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A useful next step would be to vary the planner, robot primitives, and feedback controls independently, then repeat tasks to measure reliability and elapsed time on both simulated and physical systems. For now, the lesson is precise: a model that can compose existing actions and keep intermediate checks inside a program may need fewer planning exchanges. The evidence supports that possibility on these simulated tasks, not a universal performance claim. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our A-I assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 下一步可以分别改变规划器、机器人基本动作和反馈控制，然后重复任务，在模拟系统和物理系统上测量可靠性和耗时。就目前而言，这个结论很明确：一个能够组合已有动作、并在程序内部保留中间检查的模型，可能需要的规划交互更少。这些证据支持这种可能性在这些模拟任务上成立，但并不构成普遍的性能结论。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
